follow_ups.title: Cart quantity post without UpdateQuantityId throws
follow_ups.reason: UpdateQuantityAsync dereferences UpdateQuantityId!.Value, so a crafted update-cart post with no id fails with a server error instead of a validation message; the code predates this ticket.

follow_ups.title: Cart page initial load fails when a basket line's product was deleted from the catalog
follow_ups.reason: BasketState.GetBasketItemsAsync indexes the catalog dictionary directly, so any page load of a bag holding a deleted product throws KeyNotFoundException; this predates the story.
